newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby league - Illawarra sack coach McMahon.
newsitem.headline: Rugby league - Illawarra sack coach McMahon.

text.p: The Illawarra Steelers and rugby league coach Allan McMahon have parted company, a statement jointly released by the Steelers and McMahon on Friday said.
The statement said McMahon and the club had reached an agreement on an unspecified pay-out for the renmaining two years of McMahon's $250,000 a year contract.
Illawarra would hold an emergency board meeting next week to debate a replacement for McMahon, who was to leave the job immediately.
Illawarra finished 14th in the 20-team Australian Rugby League premiership standings at the end of regular season matches.
